svg.aria-label: Layers: 42 elements and 89 relationships, grouped into 15 drawn elements and 23 drawn relationships

g.desc: Process JRN-001: Initiate payment (Journey step). It hands Screen the instruction “Screen”; uses Requirements. Context statements serves it; Events hands it “Begin”; Responsibilities realizes it.
Process JRN-002: Screen the instruction (Journey step). It uses Requirements; hands Gateways “Disposition”. Initiate payment hands it “Screen”; Responsibilities realizes it.
Process JRN-003: Record the posting (Journey step). It hands Settle the payment “Submit once”; uses Requirements. Gateways hands it “Allow”; Responsibilities realizes it.
Process JRN-004: Settle the payment (Journey step). It uses Requirements; hands Gateways “Resolve”. Record the posting hands it “Submit once”; Responsibilities realizes it.
Process JRN-005: Communicate the outcome (Journey step). It uses Requirements; hands Events “Communicate”. Gateways hands it “Confirmed”; Responsibilities realizes it.
Process initiate: Initiate payment (Journey step). It hands Screen for risk “Instruction”.
Process screen: Screen for risk (Journey step). It hands Post ledger entry “Allowed”. Initiate payment hands it “Instruction”.
Process post: Post ledger entry (Journey step). It hands Settle payment “Posted”. Screen for risk hands it “Allowed”.
Process settle: Settle payment (Journey step). It hands Confirm outcome “Outcome”. Post ledger entry hands it “Posted”.
Process confirm: Confirm outcome (Journey step). Settle payment hands it “Outcome”.
Group: Requirements (5 requirements). Initiate payment uses it; Screen the instruction uses it; Record the posting uses it; Settle the payment uses it; Communicate the outcome uses it.

Group: Responsibilities (5 responsibilities). It realizes Initiate payment; realizes Screen the instruction; realizes Record the posting; realizes Settle the payment; realizes Communicate the outcome.
Group: Gateways (2 gateways). It hands Record the posting “Allow”; hands Communicate the outcome “Confirmed”. Screen the instruction hands it “Disposition”; Settle the payment hands it “Resolve”.
Group: Events (2 events). It hands Initiate payment “Begin”. Communicate the outcome hands it “Communicate”.
Group: Context statements (3 requirements). It serves Initiate payment.
